label: DSH loads Cordis plugins through profile composition; a repo-local patch overlay is the documented explicit route, while dsh plugin installs profile dependencies.
The shipped guard package handles repeat calls and timeouts; tools/pre-execute, execute, post-execute, result, and monotonic guards provide seams for repository policy adapters.
agent/pre-step, agent creation/disposal, turn-stopping, and DSH compaction markers offer context and lifecycle seams, but require adapters rather than Pi event-name reuse.
Recommend porting core policy and context bridges, deferring host/session adapters, and leaving process relaunch to the fan-out runner; the full matrix is in iteration 6.
A repo-local package with individually mountable factories and shared policy cores is the leaner packaging unit than a separate installable package for every guard.
Preserve Pi's fail-open adapter behavior and DSH's monotonic final denial semantics explicitly; documented seams do not prove the repo's plugin works in DSH headless.
